name: kreftjs
description: A tiny reactive framework with its own component language (.kreft files): router with nested routes, stores, saved data, animations, an API client, hot reload, DevTools and a template engine.

scripts.dev: node bin/kreftjs.js dev --api demo/db.json --db sqlite:demo/database/demo.db --migrations demo/database/migrations --server demo/server --backend demo --seed
scripts.start: node bin/kreftjs.js dev --api demo/db.json --db sqlite:demo/database/demo.db --migrations demo/database/migrations --server demo/server --backend demo --seed
scripts.build: node bin/kreftjs.js build demo --out dist/demo --include docs
scripts.preview: node bin/kreftjs.js dev dist --api demo/db.json --db sqlite:demo/database/demo.db --migrations demo/database/migrations --server demo/server --backend demo --seed
scripts.test: node --test test/security.test.js test/prerender.test.js test/seo.test.js test/rebrand.test.js test/noauth.test.js test/winspawn.test.js test/htaccess.test.js test/cookie-secure.test.js test/password-rule.test.js test/headline.test.js test/menu.test.js
